subject: Reject invalid once work inputs
description:

Expose the new once grammar and reject invalid timeout, cwd, work-source, file-kind, readability, blank-content, containment, sibling-prefix, and symlink-escape inputs before process execution.

- [ ] Public boundary tests cover every approved input failure.

subject: Run one marker-backed work invocation
description:
## What to build

Run one scoped codex exec for a validated work snapshot, append the generic completion protocol, stream native stdout and stderr to their matching sinks, and return an exact marker-backed typed outcome without retaining unbounded output.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The exact case-sensitive invocation and overall markers are detected across every chunk split.
- [ ] Marker variants and complete-only output fail; markers are honored only after successful process exit and stream drain.
- [ ] Stdout and stderr stream in real time to the correct Stdio sinks.
- [ ] Output capture remains bounded and process resources close.

subject: Enforce invocation timeout supervision
description:
## What to build

Enforce configurable idle and absolute invocation deadlines through the composed once path, treating either output stream as idle activity and terminating the detached process group gracefully before five-second force-kill escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] TestClock proves either stream resets idle time while continuing output cannot reset the absolute deadline.
- [ ] Timeout arbitration is deterministic and produces distinct typed idle and absolute failures.
- [ ] Timeout requests SIGTERM with five-second force-kill escalation for the process group.
- [ ] No process, descendant, stream consumer, timer fiber, or scope remains leaked.

subject: Complete the once tracer bullet
